highlights: Developed and trained LLMs to process legal judgments, significantly accelerating legal research and case preparation.
Engineered a proprietary dataset for model training, ensuring superior performance in identifying and extracting key legal information.
Executed research to optimize model performance, directly improving the platform's accuracy and strategic utility for lawyers.
Achieved 92% accuracy in crop disease detection by developing a DenseNetV2 model for an IoT-based monitoring system.
Deployed the deep learning model on a Raspberry Pi 4, enabling real-time, video-based crop health analysis.
Awarded: Granted patent for 'Automated Spraying System', revolutionizing pesticide application with 20% efficiency gain in automation.
